added_failure_basis: The reviewed run r-20261020T204942364841-shc-locus-remeasure recorded no suite: its manifest baseline_suite and after_suite keys are empty and its tests: line reads "none", so there are no gate logs to derive failure ids from and the added-failure measure had no baseline to compare against. The count of 0 is therefore an absent measurement rather than a measured zero; no failing test id exists on either side to name. The gained commit adds no test either, so the reviewed head adds no failure id of its own.

findings.text: follow-on: render() appends the literal ", a name outside the family, so the family itself paid nothing" whenever per_name_usd is non-empty, never comparing the apportioned names against members, so the fragment cannot show by construction what it asserts; the claim holds for this record (per_name_usd names only gap_at_outboard_midplane, which is not in docs/evidence/fragments/sn-harmonize-command/shc-locus-remeasure.json's family.members) and a regeneration whose spend reached a family member would state the opposite of the data.

follow-on: record_run_cost selects its run by prefix at :265 (cost.run_id STARTS WITH $run) and then records rows[0]["run_id"] -- the highest-spend match, not the requested run -- so a short id such as the manifest's "e0509ebe" would silently record a sibling run's id and figures; the owners of this problem match exactly (imas_codex/standard_names/graph_ops.py:15899, :15911, :15929).

follow-on: the inline Cypher at :262-274 duplicates the per-phase spend aggregation owned by imas_codex/standard_names/graph_ops.py:15907 and the run total owned by :15896, differing only by a count(*), so the two definitions can drift -- the owner matches run_id exactly while this one prefixes it -- and the honest extension is to return the call count from the owner.

follow-on: still unaddressed from the predecessor review -- one of its findings, record_apply's docstring at :190 stating the spend is the campaign summary's total_cost while :229 stores the --spend argument and never reads total_cost, survives unchanged in this revision.
